text: Mai Lowe Group Product Manager, Gemini App Sep 23, 2026 We are bringing more of your favorite apps directly into Gemini. Instead of switching between tabs, you can now manage projects, design creative assets, and plan your workouts all in one place. Beginning to roll out today, you can connect new tools to Gemini across a variety of categories: To get started, connect your favorite apps in Gemini settings , or simply bring them into your chat by typing @ mention or asking directly.
